components.name: register-node
components.role: scan a public token identifier and request current server-side state

components.name: token-registry
components.role: authoritative serial, issuer, entitlement, transfer and status records

components.name: routing-engine
components.role: match eligible tokens/entitlements to opt-in fulfillment locations and users

components.name: merchant-adapter
components.role: merchant enrollment, redemption confirmation and settlement

components.name: traveler-wallet
components.role: display token ownership/possession claims, remaining entitlements and itinerary context

components.name: marketplace-adapter
components.role: optional lawful transfer/resale workflow with provenance

securityRules: Do not treat writable NFC memory as the authoritative ledger.
NFC should expose a public identifier or signed pointer; authoritative state remains server-side.
Never describe the system as unhackable.
Every redemption and transfer requires idempotency and replay protection.
Do not expose private itinerary/location data to arbitrary register nodes.
Merchant and user consent are required for routing/holding behavior.
valueModel: monetary face value, if legally applicable
legalBoundaries: Do not claim a token is legal tender, a binding contract, a security, stored value, or a government-issued coin without applicable legal review.
Land access and collection rights require actual owner/agency authorization; an NFC record cannot create rights the issuer does not possess.
Government minting and seigniorage claims require current primary-source verification.
Marketplace liquidity and resale prices are not guaranteed.
